title: Protocol Fee Expansion: v4 on Five More Chains
headline: A Uniswap Snapshot vote on turning on v4 protocol fees on Celo, Soneium, X Layer, World Chain and Zora, and lowering the target fee on two Arbitrum stablecoin pools.
summary: This Snapshot extends v4 protocol fees from the eight chains where they are live to five more where v2 and v3 fees already run: Celo, Soneium, X Layer, World Chain and Zora. It uses the same upgraded V4FeeAdapter and initial configuration as the companion fee adapter vote, and it does not enable fees on third-party hooks. Fees route to the TokenJar on each chain; UNI burned there is bridged back to Ethereum and sent to a burn address, and the post says this infrastructure is already live. It also lowers the target LP fee on the two USDC/USDG StablePair pools on Arbitrum, from 0.5 bps to 0.07 bps on the tick-spacing-1 pool and from 0.08 bps to 0.07 bps on the tick-spacing-2 pool. The post text still contains an unfilled placeholder for the companion proposal number.
risk_flags: enables protocol fees on five chains
vote: For 10,513 / Against 0 / Abstain 0 so far, ends 2026-11-21
